messages:
incident-bot: [3305007777] INCIDENT — increased 5xx rate + CPU saturations on inference fleet. Top offender: POST /v1/embeddings (traffic spike traced to partner-X api key). Paging on-call: @raj. Autopager: paging now.

raj: taking this. initial ask: can we protect chat and rerank routes while we investigate embeddings surge?

alice-sre: yes — recommend immediate per-route throttles and per-key overrides for embeddings. Goal: reduce embeddings qps from surge source and keep overall token throughput below SLO. Plan: 1) apply per-key quota override for partner-X 2) set route-level burst limits on /v1/embeddings 3) temporarily disable non-critical rerank path for that key.

evan: agree. also suggest lowering embeddings max_tokens to 256 for non-enterprise keys as a short-term cost/latency win.

alice-sre: config I'd push (will do if no objections):
```json
{
  "route": "/v1/embeddings",
  "route_limits": {
    "global_per_minute": 12000,
    "global_burst": 2000
  },
  "per_key_overrides": {
    "partner-X-key": {"per_minute": 300, "max_concurrent": 3},
    "default": {"per_minute": 1000, "max_concurrent": 10}
  },
  "feature_flags": {
    "rerank_for_partner_X": false,
    "max_tokens_default": 256
  }
}
```

support-desk: FYI customers reporting chat lag: #acct-123, #acct-456. Raising high touch notices after we have mitigation.

raj: applying per_key override for partner-X now. will set max_concurrent=3 and per_minute=300, and flip rerank flag off for that key.

deploy-bot: [3305007821] CONFIG APPLY start: config-id 2026-03-17T12:17Z by raj.

raj: applied — config-id 2026-03-17T12:17Z. watching metrics.

(2m later)

deploy-bot: [3305007940] CONFIG APPLY success: config-id 2026-03-17T12:17Z. changes propagated to 95% of fleet.

alice-sre: preliminary metrics: embeddings qps from partner-X down ~92%, overall CPU on affected hosts down 48%, chat p95 latency back to baseline. Nice work. :tada:

evan: I'll follow up with a temporary traffic-shaping rule to smooth remaining bursts (leaky-bucket limiter on ingress LB).

maria-product: what's customer impact window? support-desk can send a short note once we confirm stable. suggested msg: "We throttled high-volume embedding traffic from an integration to restore service quality; your application may have seen degraded embedding throughput for ~10 minutes. No data lost."

support-desk: will draft and prepare to send to the three affected accounts once we cross stability threshold.

raj: handing off to evan in 30m for post-mortem and long-term remediation work. leaving incident open until we verify partner changes their integration.

evan: taking over. I'll coordinate follow-up with partner engineering and schedule a canary test for revised quotas.

alice-sre: follow-up action items: [1] create permanent per-key rate-limit rule for partner-X with billing tie (avoid future bursts), [2] add alert for route-level CPU/backpressure on embeddings so we auto-throttle earlier, [3] postmortem with timeline + customer impact note.

support-desk: sent provisional notices to affected accounts template queued. will send once evan thumbs up.

raj: closing active mitigation — system stable. leaving thread for postmortem notes. :white_check_mark:
